storage: append-only JSONL hour-files <archive>/flight_plan_versions/YYYY-MM-DD-HH.jsonl (UTC hour the line was WRITTEN; gzipped after 2 hours; deleted after 7 days). CHANGES ONLY: a flight's version 1 is written together with its first change, so a never-amended flight has no line.
written_by: server/flightPlanVersionStore.ts PlanVersionArchive (fed by SwimPlanStore.onPlanContent in server/swimSfdps.ts; buffered, flushed every 15 s through datacoreArchive.appendLines)
source: FAA SWIM SFDPS flight-plan messages (Flight FIXM), as received: route text, expanded route points, airports, cruise altitude, message type and time
license: US-government FAA SWIM data. FAA LADD privacy-program aircraft are excluded at write time by callsign and withheld again at read time by hex and callsign (server/laddRegistry.ts); a LADD aircraft not yet known to the registry when its plan changed can be in a file, so raw rows must never be served without that check.

field_map.k: flight key (gufi:<GUFI>, or cs:<callsign>|<UTC day> when the message had no GUFI)
field_map.n: version number within one server run, 1 = the first route we held (restarts at 1 after a restart)
field_map.t: when we applied the message, ms epoch (our clock)
field_map.mt: the SWIM message's own timestamp, ms epoch (absent when the message carried none)
field_map.ty: SFDPS source code of the message (FH flight plan, AH amendment, ...)
field_map.rt: route text as carried (absent with rs=1: same as this flight's previous line)
field_map.rs: 1 = route text unchanged from this flight's previous line
field_map.rk: how the route points were obtained: expanded | airway | direct | radial | corridor
field_map.pn: route point names joined by | (empty = unnamed)
field_map.pc: route point coordinates, flat [lat, lon, lat, lon, ...], 5 decimal places
field_map.pz: per-point altitude in feet or null (present only when a message carried one)
field_map.ps: 1 = route points unchanged from this flight's previous line
field_map.d: what changed against the previous version, in the SWIM store's own words (versions after 1)
field_map.o: version 1 only: 1 = from a flight-plan (FH) message that was the first message we saw for the flight; 0 = the plan as first SEEN, earlier versions may exist
field_map.fs: version 1 only: when the SWIM store first saw the flight, ms epoch

confidence_model: RAW: each line is what one FAA message carried, plus our receive time. Route points of kind 'expanded' are the fix names the message carried, placed at their FAA NASR positions; the other kinds are placed by our parser from the route text. Version 1 is 'as filed' only when o=1. A version is recorded when the route text, route geometry, destination or cruise altitude changed; an amendment message that changed none of those records nothing. Lines skipped for low disk, the daily byte cap, a full buffer or a write error are counted on /api/data/aircraft/plan-status (planVersions.archive.skipped), so a gap in a flight's version numbers is visible.
cadence: event-driven (one line per detected plan change; about 109,000 lines a day estimated from the live feed, bounded at 72 MiB of raw lines per UTC day)
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). Serves GET /api/data/aircraft/plan-history/:hex after a restart and for flights that have left memory. Not in the R2 cold tier and not rolled up: the stream owns its 7-day retention (short because the volume is tight).
